Home Composting Basics

A good compost heap needs a mix of green material, such as vegetable peelings and grass cuttings, and brown material, such as cardboard and dry leaves. Aim for roughly equal amounts of each.

Turn the heap every two to three weeks to add air. A heap that smells bad is usually too wet and needs more brown material.

Do not add meat, dairy, or cooked food, as these attract rats.

Compost is usually ready in six to twelve months, when it is dark and crumbly.
